name: Lorna Crowley
summary: Lorna Crowley is the daughter of Lord Darius Crowley, a leading nobleman of Gilneas. Isolated behind the towering Greymane Wall, she remains entwined with the shifting internal politics and conflicts of the sealed human kingdom.

sections.title: Daughter of the Rebellion
sections.body: Behind the colossal stone ramparts of the Greymane Wall, the kingdom of Gilneas cut itself off from the rest of Lordaeron years ago. Lorna Crowley is the daughter of Lord Darius Crowley, a prominent nobleman who strongly resisted the kingdom's isolationist decree and the wall's construction. Growing up amidst deep political unrest and the Northgate Rebellion, Lorna shares her father's fierce spirit and martial pride while remaining tucked away from the wider events shaping the continent outside.

faq.answer: Lorna Crowley is a Gilnean noblewoman and the daughter of Lord Darius Crowley. She is known for her strong will and sharp mind, shaped by the political friction and insular struggles inside Gilneas.

faq.q: Can players meet Lorna Crowley right now?
faq.answer: No. Lorna remains sealed behind the massive Greymane Wall within the closed kingdom of Gilneas, which keeps its gates shut tight against all outsiders.

faq.q: What is her father's role in Gilneas?
faq.answer: Lord Darius Crowley is one of the kingdom's foremost noblemen. He opposed King Genn Greymane's decision to wall off the realm, eventually leading the Northgate Rebellion against the crown.

faq.q: What is happening in Gilneas behind the wall?
faq.answer: Gilneas remains in self-imposed isolation, cut off from the Alliance and the surrounding lands since the aftermath of the Second War. Its internal conflicts and daily life stay entirely hidden behind its massive barricades.

angles.text: Lorna Crowley and her family belong to the lost kingdom of Gilneas, which severed ties with the Alliance of Lordaeron to lock its gates behind the Greymane Wall.
